contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [PAX AVG] ; D/ IMP C ALLECTVS PF AVG

A copper-alloy Radiate of Allectus, AD c.293-296 (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads [PAX AVG]. Reverse shows Pax standing left holding branch and transverse sceptre. Mint of London, S A//ML. RIC V, pt.2, p. 561, no.33. Obverse legend reads IMP C ALLECTVS PF AVG. Obverse shows a radiate and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: S/A//ML. Die axis is 7 o'clock. Weight is 3.52g,…
